account_creator: A human must create the Account. Accounts registered by bots or other automated methods are not permitted. Machine accounts are only grandfathered if they pre-date Upload tokens (2019) and Organization accounts (2025), and even then a human must set them up, accept the Terms, provide a valid email, and remain responsible. A valid email and username are required.
disclosure_rule: The fetched PyPI Terms of Service do not impose an AI-specific disclosure for packages. You must have the right to post the Content, comply with third-party licenses, and not violate the Acceptable Use Policy or applicable law (including copyright).
payout_kyc: PyPI does not pay package authors. Free Accounts are not required to provide payment information. Paid Organization hosting, if used, requires a valid payment method and billing information.
copyright_notes: You retain ownership of and responsibility for Your Content. Uploads are on a non-confidential basis. If Content is not under an Included License, you grant PSF and other users an irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to reproduce and publish it on the Service. USCO Part 2 (January 2025): purely AI-generated material is not copyrightable; prompts alone are not enough.
human_must: Create the PyPI account as a human (do not register by bot).
Own any machine account that still exists and accept the Terms for it.
Provide a valid email and keep the account secure (2FA is offered).
Only upload Content you have the right to license.
quote: You must be a human to create an Account. Accounts registered by "bots" or other automated methods are not permitted. Machine accounts may be permitted if they pre-date features designed to fulfill similar duties such as Upload tokens (2019) and Organization accounts (2025).

additional_sources.quote: A machine account is an Account set up by an individual human who accepts the Terms on behalf of the Account, provides a valid email address, and is responsible for its actions.

Copyright does not extend to purely AI-generated material, or material where there is insufficient human control over the expressive elements. Based on the functioning of current generally available technology, prompts do not alone provide sufficient control.

notes: PyPI Terms effective date on the fetched page: February 25, 2025 (page also shows April 10, 2025).
